title: Following criteria record
description: The following limits predeclared on tuning data before any held-out window is read (experiment l8fol0004). The physical scorer cites a record by path and SHA-256 digest; only a pinned record admits a held-out split. internal/lidar/perframeeval/following_criteria.go is the reader and the authority: it refuses unknown fields and checks the cross-field rules this schema cannot state. A pinned file is never edited; an amendment is a new file under a new decision.

status.description: A draft may leave any value null and admits no held-out split. A pinned record names its decision and date and states every value.

decision.description: The D-NN in docs/DECISIONS.md that pinned the record; empty in a draft.

drafted_on.description: The tuning evidence the limits were drafted on. A pinned record needs split_digest and report.

report.description: Repository path of the report that sets out the limits' rationale.

gap_error_limit_m.description: Upper bound on a gap stratum's 95th percentile of |gap error| (nearest rank), metres.

reference_precision_m.description: Widest reference gap half-width that may count toward a pass; a wider reference is counted as imprecise and never scored toward a pass.

nominal_coverage.description: Coverage the predicted gap's interval claims: covered when |error| <= z sigma.

min_independent_encounters_per_stratum.description: Floor on a stratum's Kish effective count of body pairs (or follower bodies for no_leader and ambiguous records).

wrong_leader_tolerance.description: Upper bound on a leader-choice stratum's share of scored instants whose leader is wrong.

valid_following.description: The valid-following definition fixed by the maths decision review (E-01), with the ceiling chosen by E-09's rule. Recorded and validated; method following_acceptance_v1 does not yet apply it.

spatial_only_below_mph.description: Band edge below which only the spatial gap is reported; must exceed opportunity_floor_mph.

net_ceiling_s.description: Net time-gap ceiling: 4 s unless 4 s drops more than 10 % of the leader records 6 s keeps (E-09).

ceiling_provisional.description: True only for a 6 s ceiling chosen because 6 s kept fewer than ten leader records.

sensitivity_ceilings_s.description: Strictly ascending ceilings the report prints; must include net_ceiling_s.

family_confidence.description: Confidence of all of one arm's interval tests together.

correction.description: How the family's error rate is shared among the tests; empty in a draft that has not chosen.
